title: Cloud Logs read path outage on eu-west-2

updates.body:
We observed an issue which impacted the following service: reads of Cloud Logs in the eu-west-2 region. 

Affected services would include Explore, dashboards, alert evaluation when querying Logs.

The time of impact lasted from approximately 22h15 and 22h23 UTC, on loki-prod-012. This incident has since been resolved.
